Medicare has two main paths: Original Medicare is Parts A and B through the federal program; Medicare Advantage is a private plan that provides Parts A and B. With Original Medicare, you can add a separate drug plan and may be able to buy Medigap to help with your share of costs. With Advantage, most plans include drug coverage. You still pay the Part B premium either way. For visit costs, don’t look only at the monthly premium—total cost also includes deductibles, copays, and coinsurance when you use care.
